summary: Account and adoption professional with 5 years in a regulated, multi-country payments business (Global Blue, part of Shift4), promoted three times in four years. Interim account manager for three global brands, author of the onboarding playbook two global account teams adopted, and the person who gets busy teams and clients to adopt new tools. Works across sales, product and technical teams in ~40 countries.
cover_letter: I am applying for the Senior Principal Customer Success Manager role at Pagerduty. This role is about helping customers adopt and get value from what they have bought. For 5 years at Global Blue, part of Shift4, a regulated, multi-country payments business, I have done exactly that, and I have been promoted three times in four years.

For six months I was interim account manager for three global brands: Dyson, Fred Perry and UGG. I wrote the client onboarding playbook and country checklists that two global account teams adopted as standard and extended to new markets such as Peru, and I got account managers onto new Salesforce reporting by fixing their problems one by one.

I work inside account teams with sales and technical colleagues across ~40 countries. I fixed a five-month invoice reporting failure for a major retail client by tracing the fault across three systems and coordinating four system owners, and I run training and briefings for account managers, country teams and new starters.

I hold the AgilePM® v3 Practitioner certificate and an MA from the University of Sheffield, and I live in Southampton. I would put early effort into learning your tools and ways of working, while bringing delivery discipline from a regulated environment.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
